findings.opportunity: Every Candidate file edit during `xirang view` performs a full snapshot rebuild: `watcherRefreshForPath` maps `candidate/...` paths to `{ all: true }`, so the refresh closure recompiles every active Change delta (`buildChangeDerivedView` per change), regenerates the formal model's LikeC4 sources and authored views, and re-runs `generateLikeC4Artifacts(projectRoot)` which re-parses the whole model and rewrites artifact files on disk. None of these depend on the Candidate; on a candidate-only edit their outputs are byte-identical, so the work is purely redundant. This also over-refreshes relative to the declared contract `xirang-projection-service#Candidate source 按输入刷新` ('Candidate source 变化 SHALL 只刷新 manifest.candidate').
findings.impact: Candidate review is the highest-frequency authoring loop; each debounced (75ms) edit currently triggers O(active changes) delta compilations plus full model LikeC4 generation plus on-disk artifact regeneration. A candidate-only partial refresh reduces each edit to one candidate rebuild plus one formal-model read, materially cutting dev-server load, watcher churn, and latency during candidate review.

findings.recommendation: Introduce a candidate-only partial refresh: add an `onlyCandidate` option to `buildViewRuntimeSnapshot` that reuses the previous snapshot's `model`, `authoredViews` and `changes` when the re-read formal fingerprint is unchanged, extend `watcherRefreshForPath` with a `{ all: false, candidate: true }` result for candidate paths, and skip `generateLikeC4Artifacts` for candidate-only refreshes.
findings.keyDesign: buildViewRuntimeSnapshot(projectRoot, { previous, onlyChange, onlyCandidate }) semantics: (1) read the formal model once and compute its partition-fingerprint hash (`model.sourceFingerprint`); (2) `formalUnchanged = previous && previous.model.sourceFingerprint === formalFingerprint`; (3) when `formalUnchanged`, reuse `previous.model` and `previous.authoredViews` (fingerprint covers all four partitions, so identical content yields identical derived output); (4) rebuild the candidate source when `onlyCandidate === true` OR `!formalUnchanged` OR no previous exists, otherwise reuse `previous.candidate`; (5) rebuild changes only for `onlyChange` (reuse the rest), reuse all when `onlyCandidate`, rebuild all when `!formalUnchanged` or no previous; (6) the formal-fingerprint guard is the safety net: if a candidate-only refresh observes a changed formal model (e.g. a watcher event was dropped during promotion), it degrades to a full rebuild. ViewCommand.execute: track a `refreshCandidate` flag from `watcherRefreshForPath`'s new candidate member; the refresh closure runs full on `all`, one candidate-only rebuild when the candidate flag is set (running after any per-change loop in the same batch), the per-change loop otherwise, and calls `generateLikeC4Artifacts` only when `all` is set.
preservationConstraints: archive-side, missing-filename, and any `model/<partition>/` event still produce `{ all: true }` and the identical full rebuild plus `generateLikeC4Artifacts` path
